Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using HA-tagged BAG3. Quantification was performed via peptide counting (a form of LFQ). No PTM enrichments were used for the MS analysis.

scope: HEK293T human embryonic kidney cells (Sigma Aldrich, #12022001) stably expressing N-terminally HA-tagged BAG3 were harvested and lysed... and immunoprecipitated with 60 μl anti-HA resin.

Eluted immune complexes were precipitated with 20% trichloroacetic acid (TCA) and pellets were washed once with 10% TCA and four times with cold acetone. Precipitated proteins were resuspended in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate (pH 8.0) with 20% acetonitrile and incubated with sequencing grade trypsin

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry experiment (PXD014473) is a descriptive interactome study (affinity purification) of overexpressed HA-BAG3 in HEK293T cells. While the broader paper describes several differential perturbations (siRNA depletion of STK38, STK24, etc., and electrical pulse stimulation), these were analyzed via immunoblotting and qPCR, not mass spectrometry. The MS dataset itself does not contain a differential comparison axis, thus it is classified as un-classified.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The proteomics part of this study is a discovery-based interactome screen using HA-tagged BAG3. While the paper discusses phosphorylation (T444), the PRIDE metadata explicitly states 'No PTMs are included in the dataset' for the MS data (PXD014473), suggesting the MS was used for protein identification/abundance rather than site-specific PTM analysis.
